description: Added `WithRedirectUris` to the Entra ID hosting integration so externally visible OAuth callback URIs (behind a gateway, reverse proxy, or custom domain) can be supplied per environment at deployment time via parameters, instead of being hardcoded. Literal and parameter-backed URIs can be mixed. Redirect URIs can also be derived from a resource endpoint with `WithRedirectUris(EndpointReference, ...)`, following the allocated endpoint in run mode and the compute environment host in publish.
name: Parameter-backed redirect URIs for Entra ID
